changelog_text:
version 1.6.0

- added a huge feature for identifying and showing information on multiple star systems!  it has it's own tab in the window, check it out!
- compiled a self made catalog of stars combining information from the AT-HYG 4.0 catalog, WDS catalog, and others!  this brings many more ID types to display and serach by, and other information
- made the searching for stars easier by having one search area and greatly improved displaying and seraching through the possible id's of the search bar.
- various tweaks to the window UI, it will definitely kept getting changed. it's a bit busy at once sometimes now, to be cleaned up somehow later.
- many small tweaks that you probably won't notice.  for one, stars with a Bayer & Constellation use the full names now rather than abbreviations.
- fixed compatibility with KSA >=2026.10.19.5638

listing.name: OhMyStars
listing.abstract: This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!
listing.description:
This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!

Features: 
- Constellation (Asterism) Lines between stars  
- Constellation Boundary lines (IAU defined) - Star informational window  
- Star names and informational window  
- Vehicle orientation mode to point towards stars  

![OMShunter](ksa-image:OMSHunter)

A pointer can be enabled showing the direction to a currently selected star.  A navball marker can be enabled showing the orientation where the selected star is in relation to your vehicle's pointing!

![OMS3medium](ksa-image:OhMyStars3)

An orientation mode can be activated making the flight computer aim your vehicles towards the currently selected star!  Toggle the mode off to go back to the vehicle's previous orientation mode!

![OMS3medium](ksa-image:OhMyStars4)
